body.text:
Resolves #12.

### Summary
- Added `flake.nix` and `flake.lock` supporting `aarch64-darwin`, `x86_64-darwin`, `x86_64-linux`, and `aarch64-linux`.
- Builds the embedded `web/` SPA reproducibly via `pkgs.buildNpmPackage` and embeds it into `pkgs.rustPlatform.buildRustPackage` with `GETAEL_SKIP_WEB_BUILD=1`.
- Exposes `packages.<system>.default` (`getael`), `apps.<system>.default` (`nix run`), and `devShells.<system>.default` (`cargo`, `rustc`, `rustfmt`, `clippy`, `nodejs`, `sqlite`, `pkg-config`).
- Documented `nix run`, `nix profile install`, and `nix develop` in `README.md`.

### Verification
- `nix build` succeeded on `aarch64-darwin`
- `nix flake check` passed (`all checks passed!`)
- `nix run . -- --help` launched `getael` cleanly

title.text: Add Nix flake for reproducible builds and dev shell
